original_question: Two candidates are running for class representative at Sarai's school. If the winner got 3/4 of the votes and the total number of students who voted in the class was 80, calculate the number of votes the loser got.
question_template: {num_text_1, Two} candidates are running for class representative at {name_female, Sarai}'s school. If the winner got {num_frac_1, 3/4} of the votes and the total number of students who voted in the class was {num_digit_1, 80}, calculate the number of votes the loser got.
question_solution: answer = num_digit_1 * (1 - f1)   # f1 is the numeric value of num_frac_1
